column1: # Gated commands that carry no `examples_safe` — the SAFE-TWIN backlog.
# declaring a path gate — `[command.path_gate]`, `write_when`, or a central `[roles."x"]` — to also
# carry at least one `examples_safe`. The reason is the failure mode gating actually has: a gate
# that is too broad (a FORMAT flag mistaken for a path, `bazel query --output json`) denies ordinary
# usage, and nothing notices, because the ratchet only looks for MISSING gates. An `examples_safe`
# entry is the safe twin made permanent: `toml_examples_match_dispatch` then re-runs it on every
# build and fails if the gate ever swallows it.
# Seeded 2026-08-08 with the 313 that predate the rule, so it ratchets forward: a NEWLY gated command
